description: Full data of ONE museum identified by pk (use a search tool first to find the pk). Always returns: pk, title, meta_description, meta_keywords (first 5), description_html (the museum description as HTML), url (the museum page), image_url, and "links" — up to 5 ready-to-give absolute URLs of the most useful related pages (city_museums_page, museums_by_country_page, official_website, all_museums_page). museum_not_found when no such museum is published. The result is capped at 25000 characters: when description_html had to be shortened to fit, "truncated" is true.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

pk.description: The object pk, as returned by a search tool.

name: get_detail_museum
title: Get museum details
